text: ...That reminds me – what is this place?
You mean, you don't know what's going on either? Oh well, I was only just summoned here out of nowhere myself.
Yeah. A hidden monster-slaying quest popped up on my screen. Just when I hit "Accept," I saw this blinding flash of light. When I came to my senses again, I was here.
...Strange. This isn't some sort of bug, is it?
Sure. I accepted the quest, so I intend to see it through. But first things first – let's take stock of the situation.
Leave it to me. The streets aren't safe right now, we'd better hurry...
Kirito suddenly lunges forward with a swing of his sword to block an incoming arrow.
These monsters have ranged attacks, too?!
Oh no, nyaa...! We're surrounded, there's no way we can make a run for it now, nyaa...
That big dark one looks tough! Are you sure you'll be okay on your own, Kirito, nyaa?!
Who said I was on my own?
Now's not the time for compliments...! You gave us all a fright, running off so suddenly like that.
Haha, sorry about that. But I knew you'd catch up with me, Asuna.
O-of course! We rushed over as fast as we could!//nEveryone, let's take them down!
Got it! I'll send these weaklings flying with my wind magic!
Amazing! You took out most of those monsters in no time, nyaa!
But the biggest one is still... Huh? Is that... a laser sight?
So strong... That wiped them all out...
I'd like to ask where we are... but I guess that'll have to wait.
Agreed. Let's find a safe place to regroup and assess the situation first.
I know One Han City like the back of my hand! As for a safe place... there's a cafe nearby, follow me!
You're Ichihime, right? And the one beside you... Your nickname reads {var:player_nickname}... Cool name. Nice to meet you both.
{var:player_nickname}, are you familiar with the area? If you've been here before, you should have quite a bit of intel already.
